wide.default_movement: locked-off hold with gentle atmospheric drift
wide.instruction: Wide establishing shot of the environment; keep horizon stable.

medium.instruction: Medium framing on subject; hold eyeline and background continuity.

close_up.instruction: Close-up on face or detail; shallow depth of field.

extreme_close_up.instruction: Extreme close-up on critical detail; clean edges, no shake.

drone.instruction: Drone / aerial overview; steady altitude and gentle forward glide.

tracking.instruction: Tracking shot following subject motion; keep subject framed consistently.

pov.instruction: POV shot from subject viewpoint; natural head-scale motion.

cinematic.instruction: Cinematic camera move with deliberate motivation; smooth start and settle.
